pins.title: All 64 national parks on one free list
pins.sub: Tick them off as you go.
pins.board: Best Day Hikes in US National Parks
pins.pinTitle: Free printable checklist of all 64 US national parks, updated with Chiricahua (2026)
pins.description: A free printable checklist of all 64 US national parks, including Chiricahua, the newest park. Tick off each park you visit and write the year, with a 'next 5 parks' wish list. Free PDF in US Letter and A4, color and printer-friendly.

pins.title: How many of the 64 have you seen?
pins.pinTitle: US national parks checklist printable, free: track all 64 parks you have visited
pins.description: Collecting national parks? Print our free list of all 64 US national parks A to Z with the state, a checkbox and a year line, plus a parks-visited tally. Checked against the NPS list in November 2026. Free download, nothing is shipped.

pins.title: Ski boots on, warm feet all day
pins.sub: Merino socks for the slopes too.
pins.pinTitle: Merino wool socks for ski trips: warm, cushioned crew socks for cold boots and long days
pins.description: Cold ski boots and long days on the slopes: our merino wool crew socks (80% merino) have a cushioned sole, stay warm when damp and resist odor, so they work for ski trips as well as winter walks, work and travel.

pins.title: Cold dog walks? Start with warm socks.
pins.sub: Soft merino for every winter walk.
pins.pinTitle: Warm merino wool socks for winter dog walks, snowy mornings and cold commutes
pins.description: Early dog walks in the snow and wet boots at the door: a cushioned merino wool crew sock keeps feet warm and comfortable for the walk and the rest of the day. 80% merino, four colours.

pins.title: Hiking at 30°F? Dress like this.
pins.pinTitle: What to wear hiking in 30 degree weather: base layer, fleece, shell, hat, gloves and wool socks
pins.description: What to wear hiking at 30°F (-1°C): a base layer, leggings, a fleece, a windproof shell, a warm hat, gloves and wool socks, plus a puffy for stops. What changes in wind, snow and ice, and what to leave at home.

pins.title: First winter hike? Start here.
pins.sub: What to wear and what to bring.
pins.pinTitle: Winter hiking checklist for beginners: what to wear and bring on a cold day hike
pins.description: A simple winter day-hike checklist for beginners: the three layers to wear, the winter extras to pack, how to keep water and batteries working in the cold, and how to plan a short, safe first winter hike.

pins.title: Thinking about a long trail next year?
pins.pinTitle: Long trail planner printable: section hike and thru-hike workbook for the AT, PCT and more
pins.description: Winter is when long trails get planned. A 32-page printable workbook for a section hike or thru-hike: trail comparison, permits, daily mileage, resupply, budget, food and water, gear weights in oz and g, plus daily trail log pages. A good gift for the hiker who keeps talking about it.

pins.title: How much water for 5 miles?
pins.sub: About 1 to 1.5 liters on a mild day.
pins.pinTitle: How much water to bring for a 5 mile hike: liters per hour, hot days and cold weather
pins.description: For a 5-mile hike of 2 to 3 hours, bring about 1 to 1.5 liters of water in mild weather and 2 to 3 liters on a hot day or a hard climb. How to work it out by the hour, how to carry it, and tips for cold weather.

pins.title: Planning Banff and Jasper?
pins.pinTitle: Banff and Jasper trip planner printable: Canadian Rockies itinerary, Moraine Lake and day hikes
pins.description: A printable guide for a first trip to Banff and Jasper: when to go, what to book and in what order, how to reach Lake Louise and Moraine Lake without a private car, and 3, 5 and 7-day itineraries with the best day hikes.

pins.title: Remember every hike this year
pins.pinTitle: Hiking journal printable: trail log book with a 52 hike tracker, gift for hikers
pins.description: A printable hiking journal for one year of hikes: a 52-hike tracker, a miles and km total, a trail bucket list and 52 log pages for distance, elevation, weather, wildlife and the best moment. US Letter and A4. A thoughtful gift for a hiker.
